turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently don’t ship worldwide.

Here’s how it works:

• We ship within the contiguous United States, with limited availability to Alaska, Hawaii, and select regions in Canada. • We do not ship to other international locations outside the U.S. and Canada, so customs or duties are not an issue for those countries. • For eligible orders shipping to Canada, prices are shown in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the listed price, so there are no additional customs charges on delivery.

If you tell me where you’re located, I can confirm what options (if any) are available for your area.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping is pretty quick, but it depends a bit on where you are and what you choose at checkout:

• For most U.S. addresses, transit time is typically about 1–5 business days once your order leaves our nursery. • At checkout, you’ll choose an estimated arrival date from our delivery calendar. Those options already factor in our processing time plus the carrier’s typical transit time to your area. • For Canadian orders, you’ll choose a ship week instead. Orders usually arrive the following week after the week you select.

We only offer standard ground shipping (no express or same-day), and all dates are estimates since carriers can occasionally have delays.

If you tell me whether you’re in the U.S. or Canada and what you’re thinking of ordering (roses, bulbs, perennials), I can give a more tailored expectation.
